scenes.big: A Christmas gift they'll use daily
scenes.en: New glasses for Amma and Appa.
scenes.say: Looking for a Christmas gift your parents will use every single day? Karthik found one.

scenes.en: Amma squinted at small print. Appa's old frame was taped.
scenes.ta: அம்மா படிக்க சிரமப்பட்டார், அப்பா கண்ணாடி உடைந்திருந்தது
scenes.say: Amma was squinting at small print, and Appa's old frame was held together with tape.

scenes.en: Free in our store. Home eye test in Chennai: ₹100 for the whole family.
scenes.say: First, an eye test. It's free in our store, and our home eye test in Chennai is one hundred rupees for the whole family.

scenes.en: On spectacles with LenzKare Fusion lenses. One for Amma, one for Appa.
scenes.ta: 1 வாங்கினால் 1 இலவசம்: அம்மாவுக்கு ஒன்று, அப்பாவுக்கு ஒன்று
scenes.say: Then, buy one get one free on spectacles with LenzKare Fusion lenses. One pair for Amma, one for Appa.

scenes.en: FOE frames from ₹899. Single vision lenses from ₹1,500.
scenes.say: FrameOra frames start at eight hundred and ninety nine rupees, and single vision lenses from fifteen hundred.

scenes.en: Free delivery in South India. 7-day exchange. 6-month frame warranty.
scenes.say: The parcel came home. Delivery is free in South India, with a seven day exchange and a six month frame warranty.
Merry Christmas! Gift your parents clear vision this season.
